summary.headline: Inception and Sign Chapters
summary.text: Astrological chapter list covering tropical, bicorporeal, and solid signs; sign likenesses; conjunctions and full moons; inceptional methods, luminaries, Sun and Moon; star mixtures, nodes, outcomes, rulers, benefits and harms, tabular synopsis, universal precepts, the twelve-place system, and buying, with cross-references to Vatican, Vindobon, Florentine, and Paris codices.
